## Class Notes 11/5

- Walked through Big Query

- Don't need to put in billing information unless we want to transfer over info from GA4

- Went through the Modules and explained Data Analysis Table

- Look at decision framework on powerpoint slide to decide which hypothesis test to use. 6-2?

- The two tests are Parametric Test and Non-Parametric

- This slide can help us decide what tests to run for example , t-test, z-test, Chi-square, k-s, Runs, Bromial

- Use more than 2 groups we use Anova , if only two groups we use T-test

  #### Multivariate Techniques: 

- Dependent Technique

- One Depended Variable: Cross Tabulation , Anlysis of Variance and Covariance, Multiple Regression

- More Than one Dependent Variable: Multivariate Analysis Variance and Covariance, Cononical correlation, Multiple Discriminant Analysis

- Intradependent Tecnhnique

- Variable Interdependence: Factor Analysis

- Interobject Similarity: Cluster Analysis, Multidimensional Scaling.
